dct_description_sm: Knowledge of arctic zooplankton community structure, dynamics and diversity has to be improved, especially during the long but poorly studied overwintering season. As a contribution to the IPY-CFL scientific program, this dataset is aimed at describing the zooplankton assemblages and their vertical distribution in the Cape Bathurst polynya complex from autumn 2007 to early summer 2008.
dct_title_s: Mesozooplankton vertical distribution data in the Cape Bathurst polynya complex, southern Beaufort Sea
